meta.title: Employer absent from the register under every alias; posting offers sponsorship

payload.requisition_text:
Founding Engineer
Copperwaite Studio · Hackney, London

Copperwaite is a two-founder studio building collaborative tooling for architecture practices: drawing review, issue tracking on plans, client sign-off. Four design partners, first paying customer last month, pre-seed closed.

As the first engineering hire you'd own the stack end to end: Rails API, React front end, Postgres, deployed on Render. You'd talk to users weekly.

We want 2+ years somewhere you shipped fast, comfort with ambiguity, and the instinct to delete code.

£41,000 plus meaningful equity. We are happy to sponsor visas for international candidates. Coffee walks along Regent's Canal count as meetings.

expected.determining_fact: Copperwaite Studio appears on no row of the sponsor register under any name or alias — without a licence, no Certificate of Sponsorship can be issued, whatever the posting promises.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: We are happy to sponsor visas for international candidates

design_notes: The inversion of refusal_licensed: stated willingness without a licence. Early-stage companies say yes in good faith and cannot deliver; the register is the fact, the promise is not. register_fixture_orgs is empty and Copperwaite Studio is in asserted_absent_names — the absence is verified against the committed snapshot under every normalisation and alias (amendment 4).
